article.title: Fascism-Forward: Into the shadows with Hindu Nationalism
article.author: Editor
article.content: Fascism-forward nationalism, held patriotic by Hindutva, portends the imaginary of India as a Hindu Nation. In its pursuit, a “deeper state” has been established whose malevolent operations polarise and religionise the body politic. The post Fascism-Forward: Into the shadows with Hindu Nationalism appeared first on MR Online .
